summary: Spot check, September 2026: 112 clinics picked at random from the main list were each looked up against independent web sources (the clinic's own website, health-system location pages, business listings). 65 (58%) were confirmed at the listed address, 9 (8%) are open at a new address, 27 (24%) could not be confirmed online either way, and 11 (10%) were wrong (closed, not a clinic, or a different specialty). Injury Physicians checked best: 30 of 37 confirmed. In the Older Entries sheet, 10 of 41 checked were confirmed.
